The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons titles and describes it as an icon of Gerasimus of the Jordan with a lion, Russia, 16th century. The lion is the attribute proper to the Jordan abbot (d. 475) and not to Gerasimos of Kephalonia or Gerasimos of Karpenisi. Commons describes it: Икона Герасима Иораднского
